newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-DONIZETE TO LEAVE BENFICA FOR BRAZIL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DONIZETE TO LEAVE BENFICA FOR BRAZIL.

text.p: Brazilian striker Donizete and Benfica have parted company on less than friendly terms with two years of his contract to run.
Benfica's sports manager 'Toni' Oliveira said on Monday Donizete would be joining Brazilian club Corinthians.
No details of the deal were released but Portuguese newspapers speculated that the fee would be $3 million.
"Benfica need players with character and somehow that was missing. We can't have players on the team who are against us," Toni said.
Donizete had not settled in well at Benfica and had come under fire for criticising his team mates.
He cited family and financial reasons for his return to Brazil.
